Tyler has been accused multiple times (Lines 23, 26, 100, 110) and has made conflicting claims about his role (Drunk, Werewolf, Robber).

10. **Formulate Justification:** The justification must explain why I chose this player, acknowledging the uncertainty inherent in the game while adhering to the goal of eliminating a Werewolf.
